# PERMIT DENIED

> A single-player browser demolition arcade game by Columbia Cloudworks LLC.
> Drive a bulldozer, smash buildings, and push rubble. Play a timed County
> Clock challenge or explore Sandbox without a deadline or breakdowns.

## Official sources

- [Game information](https://permitdenied.app/game-info.txt): Plain-text description of gameplay, modes, sites, and controls. Readable without JavaScript.
- [Play PERMIT DENIED](https://permitdenied.app/): Browser game with structured game information in the HTML head.
- [Publisher](https://columbiacloudworks.com/): Columbia Cloudworks LLC.
